name: Simplex Noise Chunk Generation
aliases: Procedural Chunk Generation with Simplex Noise
definition: Generates a voxel chunk's geometry and data using a 3D simplex noise function to determine voxel presence/height, allocating vertex and index buffers for rendering.
summary: Simplex Noise Chunk Generation creates volumetric voxel terrain by evaluating 3D simplex noise, differing from heightmaps and complex cave systems by using a single scalar threshold.
